account:
It is noon on day 0, and I have reached home for my scheduled lunch after the market walk. The only unusual report so far concerns lights at the bakery. My neighbour said Townsfolk 02 had reported that the bakery was being decorated with lights this morning. Neither my neighbour nor I knows what occasion, if any, they might mark. When we asked the baker directly, the baker denied arranging decorations or planning a celebration and said they had been baking that morning. Oven light is therefore a possible explanation, but I have not seen the lights myself or spoken to Townsfolk 02 to check the original observation. I have no evidence yet of a secret gathering or of anyone misleading me.

The baker was selling fresh bread and asking whether any upcoming gatherings would need extra bread. Townsfolk 10 and 20 also reported seeing the baker carrying a sack of bread at the bridge; this seems consistent with supplying the market stall, rather than evidence of anything unusual. Other residents offered no news. The secretary likewise had no news earlier.

My neighbour confirmed our usual tea at three at the dockside cottage, coordinates (16, -60, 105). That invitation now appears to be an ordinary scheduled visit, not an unexplained event. After lunch I am due at the office at one for town accounts, then tea, then back at the office at half past four. I remain curious about the bakery report, but should distinguish that unverified report from what I have actually observed and keep my appointments.
